Where it stands

Every mark from the workshop is in the app, and they follow whatever palette is on. Intrusive is a new design you can put under any skin. Four decisions at the bottom are yours. After them it merges and installs.

01It follows the palette

A skin that only looked right in Tactical's cyan would just be a theme. The test is whether it survives the palette you actually run.

02Intrusive

03Every surface

The window is only half of it. Every floating panel goes through the same finishing step, so changing that step once changed all of them. The diagram after the photographs shows where the change landed in the system.

04Yours

1 · Merge and install

One pull request with OPS, Intrusive, the docs and the changelog.

Recommendation: merge it, then install for your next launch. The window you're in keeps running until you reopen it.

2 · Square panes and switches under Deco and Console too

Rounded pane frames and pill switches looked wrong on a cut deck. The fix squares them under any skin that rounds nothing, which includes Deco and Console.

Recommendation: keep it. Both skins already promise square corners everywhere, and these two were the exceptions.

3 · How hot Intrusive glows

Figure 5's close-up. Strength is one number, letter_glow, in the design file.

Recommendation: ship at 1.0 and tune it from your screen. It hot-reloads like any theme.

4 · The surfaces no skin reaches

The document square, the FOCUS reader, the pane menus, find and the pickers draw their own colours, so OPS cannot reach them yet.

Recommendation: one pass that gives them all to the skin at once, so every skin benefits rather than just OPS. Filed as the bypass-surfaces issue, with the exact list.

05 Behind this

How it was checked

measured on this machine, 2026-10-20

Tests. cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast on the branch: 2,509 pass across seven targets, 0 fail and 9 are ignored, including the 74 snapshot-engine tests driven through Chromium. The unit binary runs 2,403 plus 8 ignored against 2,412 test attributes in source. The gap of one is the feature-gated core-alacritty test. New tests cover the cut plate's geometry, pips never drawing unknown as zero, only OPS changing the chrome's type, OPS wearing every new device, Tactical asking for OPS, letter glow belonging to Intrusive alone and dying with the CRT, and the bleed keeping each run's colour.

Gates. cargo fmt --check clean, cargo clippy --locked -- -D warnings clean.

Native. One frozen release binary, td-ops-5a0bd02f, run once per scene in a hidden window on a special workspace. Each scene had its own session, config, cache and state, so nothing touched your live window. Each capture was taken with grim -T at 1576×950 logical pixels, ×1.6 display scale. The Tactical scenes never pick a skin, and skin status answered active=ops: OPS arrives because the design asks for it. The rig is in reports/2026-10-20-ops-skin-evidence/.

The zero. The plan worried that Share Tech Mono's zero would look like a capital O at 11 px. At 3× on the counters, its zero carries an inner stroke, so the two can't be confused. It stays.

Not checked. A tab strip on the top band (this layout files tabs in the left bar, so the tab cradle never appears), light palettes beyond the colour arithmetic, and real subscription data in place of the demo's.

What the photographs caught

fixed before this page

  • The notice's chevrons stacked above and below the text, because the chip laid its children out as a column. It is a row now.
  • Rounded pane frames inside a cut deck. Panes are squared under any skin that rounds nothing.
  • Letter glow at one pixel read as bold type, not glow. A second, fainter ring two pixels out turned it into light.
  • The subscription panel still drew rails: your double bars, the surface you named. It draws pips now, and its tabs follow the skin's corners.
  • Selecting in the accent failed the house rule that the selection is never the furniture's colour. No colour recipe passed on all 27 palettes. The fix was the slab: the Pip-Boy bar is a solid block of the accent with dark text on it, and the edge devices keep the separate selection colour.
